summary.text: Van Smith, listed by Ballotpedia as Ivan Smith, is a Republican state representative from Alabama House District 42 who took office in November 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Smith assumed office in the Alabama House on November 6, 2019.

In the 2025-2026 session Smith served on the Agriculture and Forestry Committee and the House Education Policy Committee, and was vice chair of the Transportation, Utilities and Infrastructure Committee.
